summary: Nicola Mining Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an August 17, 2026 news release announcing a Mining and Milling Profit Share Agreement with Red Eye Resources Ltd., a private British Columbia explorer. Under the agreement, Red Eye may transport qualifying precious-metal mineralized material to Nicola's permitted Merritt Mill for processing, with profits shared equally. This is an ordinary commercial/operational arrangement, not a special-situation corporate event. No deal terms such as price, premium, or close date were provided. The filing is routine, so it does not qualify for special-situations classification.
